personality_one_liner: A cinematic, expensive, and hyper-transparent command center wrapped in smoked glass and antique gold.

spacing.rule: Generous cinematic spacing. Content must breathe. Use md/lg for internal card padding, xl for section separation.

do's: Use heavy glass (expo-blur) over brandTertiary tint for all bottom sheets and drawer overlays
Apply frosted glass to the warranty badge on Services
Use glass headers for sheets that scroll
dont's: Do not blur dense form fields or reply inputs
Do not stack more than 2 glass surfaces (e.g., sheet + sticky header is max)

screens.name: LivePreview_Tabs
screens.purpose: Provides complete transparency and rich drill-down capabilities into every merchant vertical without dead-ends.

states.loading: Cinematic shimmer skeleton across widgets, ensuring the frame remains dark and stable.
states.empty: Gold-tinted abstract illustrations with a distinct call to action.
states.error: Frosted glass error card with a 'إعادة المحاولة' (Retry) primary CTA.

screens.layout:
Tab 1: Store (المتجر) - Fix Analytics sheet data binding.
Tab 2: Services (الخدمات) - Rich detail sheets triggered by full card tap.
Tab 3: Competitions (المسابقات) - Detail sheets covering participants, outcomes, and winners.
Tab 4: Social - Feed with transparent access to likers, sharers, and direct store replies.
Global: Robust error boundaries for heatmap and drill-downs.

empty_competitions.alt: Abstract dark cinematic podium for empty competitions

empty_comments.alt: Abstract floating dark glass for empty social interactions

instructions_to_main_agent: A. INTERACTION REPAIR: 1) Store Tab: Trace the '📊 إحصائيات' button in ProductsSection. The 'لا بيانات' state is triggering before data resolves. Add a skeleton loader in the sheet and fix the data prop passing. 2) Services & Competitions: Wrap the entire image/card in a Pressable. Tapping it must trigger 'ServiceDetailSheet' and 'CompetitionDetailSheet' respectively. Add a subtle 'اعرض التفاصيل' glass pill or chevron on the card as a tap hint.

B. CONTENT SECTIONS IN SHEETS: 1) ServiceDetailSheet: Header (Image + Glass Title) -> Quick KPIs -> Technician Info -> Reviews/Comments List -> Likers row. 2) CompetitionDetailSheet: Header -> Event Status/Outcome -> Winners & Prizes (if ended) -> Participants Funnel -> Comments.

C. DESIGN CORRECTIONS: In ServicesSection, locate the warranty badge ('ضمان 30 يوم'). Change its position to 'absolute', 'bottom: 12', 'right: 12' inside the image container. Use a glassmorphism pill (`expo-blur`) with `brandPrimary` text and an icon. Ensure `hitSlop={{ top: 10, bottom: 10, left: 10, right: 10 }}` on all interactive badges.

D. COMPLETE TRANSPARENCY (SOCIAL): 1) LikersSheet: Triggered by tapping the '❤️ 12.4k' text. Show a bottom sheet with a FlatList of avatars, names, and timestamps. 2) SharersSheet: Show External Sharers categorized by platform (TikTok, Snap, IG, WA) with counts and user lists. 3) CommentsSheet: Implement a 'Reply as Store' form at the bottom of the comments list. Allow editing/deleting merchant replies.

E. EMPTY/ERROR STATES: Implement global ErrorBoundary for the 'General' tab to catch 'Not Found' 404s and replace infinite spinners with a 'بيانات غير متوفرة' state with a Retry button. For Heatmap, ensure it delays rendering until the container is measured (cold start fix).

F. DELIGHTFUL COMPETITIVE EDGE (MICRO-INTERACTIONS): When the merchant taps a user in the 'LikersSheet' or 'CommentsSheet', use Reanimated to expand that row inline instantly, revealing a gold-tinted mini-dashboard for that user: 'القيمة الدائمة (LTV): 450 SAR | الطلبات: 5 | القسم المفضل: عطور'. No extra network request if possible (mock inline), accompanied by a 'selection' haptic.
